messages:
alex_sales: Quick heads-up — AcmeBank POC asking for SOC2 report excerpt + ISO timestamps, pen-test letter signed, and presigned upload for sample logs. Deadline: Wed EOD. Who can own?
morgan_security: I can handle SOC2 redacted PDF and network diagram. Need clarity on pen-test signatory — CISO vs third-party. Also: will they accept redacted vulns? :thinking_face:
jamie_solutions: We prefer presigned S3 links (short TTL) over shared SFTP. Do they need staging creds or just upload link? Also confirm data residency for logs.
alex_sales: Customer says upload to our presigned S3 fine, no creds. They asked for pen-test letter with vendor sign-off + our attestation to scope. SLA question: will providing evidence increase risk SLA or cost?
morgan_security: Providing evidence won't change SLA. Dedicated capacity / Dedicated customers have slightly different clause, but for hosted POC it's same. Pen-test letter: legal needs to sign 'on behalf of company' — we can attach template. I'll ping legal.
lina_salesops: Timeline check: if morgan generates docs today, we can get legal sign-off tomorrow AM and upload by Wed noon. Is that OK?
devops_bot: Presigned bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence-acme/pocevidence/ — Note: links expire in 72h. (auto)
jamie_solutions: If we use 72h TTL we should coordinate upload time. Also include sample log set (30MB) and network diagram (PNG). I'll prep manifest.
alex_sales: Perfect. Morgan - can you drop the redacted SOC2 + pen-test template here when ready? @hector_legal please advise on signatory options.
morgan_security: Dropping redacted SOC2 and pen-test_template v2.0 in presigned bucket shortly. We'll redact customer-specific names and IPs. For pen-test, legal prefers CISO signature or delegated security lead; phototyped isn't acceptable. :+1:
hector_legal: Confirm: CISO signature required for final letter. We can prep an interim attestation signed by Security Lead for POC, but customer prefers CISO. If timeline tight, offer interim + final after CISO signs next week.
alex_sales: OK we'll offer interim attestation now + CISO-signed final later. Customer ok with that per call. Lina prepare upload instructions and strawman email.
lina_salesops: Will do. I'll post S3 presigned links and upload steps here once files are in bucket. ETA 2 hours.
jamie_solutions: Note for ops: remove any internal IPs from diagrams; use anonymized ranges 10.0.0.0/8. Also, let's include MD5 checksums.
morgan_security: Files uploaded: SOC2_redacted.pdf, pen-test_template_v2.docx, network_diagram_anonymized.png, logs_sample_30mb.tar.gz — links posted to bucket. I'll DM the links.
alex_sales: Thanks all. I'll update Acme contact with interim attestation + upload ETA. :rocket:
hector_legal: I'll queue CISO signature for next Tue. If they push earlier, ping me.
